These targets are in turn targeted by different compounds, including 6-Acetonyldihydrochelerythrine, CID 21778290, and Ergocryptine. The shared involvement of the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase in the signaling pathways of these compounds indicates a possible mechanism of action, where the compound may modulate the kinase activity, potentially influencing SN12K1 function. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the consistent targeting of the kinase by multiple drugs. The evidence highlights the kinase as a key mediator in the interaction between the compound and SN12K1, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction.
